tools.name: klenty_list_lists
tools.description: List the prospect lists the team created in Klenty. Use a list name with klenty_list_prospects_by_list. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/lists.

tools.name: klenty_list_prospects_by_list
tools.description: List the prospects in one prospect list, with paging. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects?listName=&start=&limit=.

tools.name: klenty_list_prospects_created
tools.description: List the prospects created between two dates. With no end date, Klenty uses today. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects?startDate=&endDate=.

tools.name: klenty_list_prospects_updated
tools.description: List the prospects whose last update (last interaction) falls in a date range. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects?lastUpdatedDateStart=&lastUpdatedDateEnd=.

tools.name: klenty_get_prospect_status
tools.description: Get the cadence status and the prospect status of one prospect, by email. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects/{prospectEmail}/status.

tools.name: klenty_list_company_cadences
tools.description: List all cadences (follow-up sequences of emails, tasks and calls) in the team. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/cadences.

tools.name: klenty_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the account, with their URLs and ids. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/webhook/getall.

tools.name: klenty_create_prospect
tools.description: Create a prospect from the given fields. A list name that does not exist is created. Blank list = the default list. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects.

tools.name: klenty_update_prospect
tools.description: Update the given fields of one prospect (found by its current email). Only the fields you pass change. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects/{prospectEmail}.

tools.name: klenty_start_cadence
tools.description: Add a prospect to a cadence. The cadence then sends its emails and tasks to the prospect on schedule. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/startcadence.

tools.name: klenty_stop_cadence
tools.description: Remove a prospect from one cadence, or from all cadences when no cadence name is given. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/stopcadence.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: klenty_list_lists, klenty_list_prospects_by_list, klenty_list_prospects_created, klenty_list_prospects_updated, klenty_get_prospect_status, klenty_list_company_cadences, klenty_list_webhooks, klenty_create_prospect · Public sink: klenty_list_lists, klenty_list_prospects_by_list, klenty_list_prospects_created, klenty_list_prospects_updated, klenty_get_prospect_status, klenty_list_company_cadences, klenty_list_webhooks, klenty_create_prospect, klenty_update_prospect, klenty_start_cadence, klenty_stop_cadence · Destructive: klenty_stop_cadence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: klenty_list_lists, klenty_list_prospects_by_list, klenty_list_prospects_created, klenty_list_prospects_updated, klenty_get_prospect_status, klenty_list_company_cadences, klenty_list_webhooks, klenty_create_prospect · Public sink: klenty_list_lists, klenty_list_prospects_by_list, klenty_list_prospects_created, klenty_list_prospects_updated, klenty_get_prospect_status, klenty_list_company_cadences, klenty_list_webhooks, klenty_create_prospect, klenty_update_prospect, klenty_start_cadence, klenty_stop_cadence · Destructive: klenty_stop_cadence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
